_meta.title: Titus — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 3 chapters of Titus. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 56 Titus); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-2, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.plain: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began;

verses.text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.plain: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people,

verses.text: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.plain: teaching us to say no to ungodliness and worldly desires, and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in this present age,

verses.text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.plain: he saved us — not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy — through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,
